title: Back To Bed Scroll
description: Craft a scroll and go teleport back to (your) bed.
body:
# Teleport to your Bed with a craftable item.

## Installation
Drag and drop into your datapack folder, just like any other datapack.

## Recipe:
Bed (Any color), Ender Pearl and Paper. Its shapeless so you can craft it in any order.

![Crafting Recipe (Shapeless) for the scroll.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cebedd2241cd6d1210ade44a3def9becc73982ee.png)

## Usage
Hold the scroll and right-click to go back to your bed.

Note: If you don't have a bed respawn point, it will fail. So you MUST have set your bed as a respawn point. 

## Resource Pack?
Not needed. The item is just paper with an enchantment glint.
